nvitk.core.array¶

High-level helpers to coerce arrays to the active NumPy or CuPy backend.

Functions¶

is_cupy_array(→ bool)

True if arr is a cupy.ndarray.

is_numpy_array(→ bool)

True if arr is a numpy.ndarray.

to_cupy(arr[, copy, strict])

Move arr to CuPy, or return NumPy array if strict is False and CuPy is unavailable.

to_numpy(→ numpy.ndarray)

Materialize arr on CPU as numpy.ndarray (get() for CuPy).

as_backend_array(→ Any)

Convert arr to NumPy or CuPy using get_current_backend() when backend is None.

ensure_same_backend(→ tuple[Any, Ellipsis])

Apply as_backend_array() to each input with the same backend (or current).

nvitk.core.array.is_cupy_array(arr: Any) → bool¶

True if arr is a cupy.ndarray.

nvitk.core.array.is_numpy_array(arr: Any) → bool¶

True if arr is a numpy.ndarray.

nvitk.core.array.to_cupy(arr: Any, copy: bool = False, strict: bool = False)¶

Move arr to CuPy, or return NumPy array if strict is False and CuPy is unavailable.

Parameters:

strict – If True, raise BackendUnavailableError when CuPy cannot load.

nvitk.core.array.to_numpy(arr: Any, copy: bool = False) → numpy.ndarray¶

Materialize arr on CPU as numpy.ndarray (get() for CuPy).

nvitk.core.array.as_backend_array(arr: Any, backend: str | None = None, copy: bool = False, strict: bool = False) → Any¶

Convert arr to NumPy or CuPy using get_current_backend() when backend is None.

Parameters:

  • arr – Any array-like or CuPy/NumPy array.

  • backend – numpy/cpu/np or cupy/gpu/cp; default follows current context.

  • copy – Force a copy on conversion.

  • strict – For CuPy: raise BackendUnavailableError if CuPy missing.

Raises:

ValueError – Unknown backend string.

nvitk.core.array.ensure_same_backend(*arrays: Any, backend: str | None = None) → tuple[Any, Ellipsis]¶

Apply as_backend_array() to each input with the same backend (or current).
